v2_source.morphometry: ${PATHOLOGY_V2_ROOT}/分类数据/肾脏疾病分类汇总.xlsx

task.patient_unit: earliest canonical check per PT within paper window

linkage.publication_caveat: Fallback links (all methods other than exact_stem) require a manually audited linkage sample before inferential publication use.

feature_definitions.sex_binary: M=1, F=0; other/missing imputed within fold
feature_definitions.sclerosis_rate: (explicit global + segmental sclerotic counts) / TEM glomerulus count
feature_definitions.gbm_thickness_nm: reported single value or range midpoint, normalized to nm

analysis_protocol.split: patient-level earliest canonical check; 2014-2021 development, 2022-2026-04 test
analysis_protocol.preprocessing: median imputation and standardization fitted within each CV fold
analysis_protocol.missingness_note: The clinical-feature models did not add missingness indicators. A separate missingness-only diagnostic baseline used nine binary missing/not-missing flags.
analysis_protocol.model_selection_note: The temporal test set was not used for tuning. Random forest was prespecified for direct-binary and source-holdout analyses.

limitations: Disease labels are rule-derived from report content and are not an independent pathology gold standard.
Fallback morphometry linkage is not manually audited; exact-stem-only sensitivity analysis remains necessary before publication.
Strong calendar-template drift and differential feature missingness can affect transport performance.
GBM thickness and spike formation are sparsely documented; fold-contained imputation does not recover absent measurements.
Source holdouts share one regional ultrastructural service and are not independent external-center validation.

exact_stem_only_sensitivity.definition: linked by a unique normalized report filename stem; no fallback key

major_source_loho.interpretation: Cross-referral-source transport validation within one regional ultrastructural service; it is not independent external-laboratory validation.
